plugin.name: Workspace_Nested_Child_Omit
plugin.author: MUSHclient contributors
plugin.purpose: Independent callback for nested synthetic child omission

muclient.script: local path=GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(),6) local enabled=WorldName()=='Workspace isolated integration' and GetAlphaOption('site')=='127.0.0.1' function OnPluginLineReceived(line) if enabled and line:find('WS_CHILD',1,true) then local f=io.open(path..'.receipt.txt','a');if f then f:write('CHILD_CALLBACK_OMIT\n');f:close() end return false end return true end
